channel.title: Pysano Updates
channel.description: Stable and beta updates for Pysano.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.8
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 8
- Added an experimental Live Translation section with separate Video and Meeting modes. - Select an application's audio and a target language for spoken translation, with independent original-audio and translated-voice volume controls. - Added a separate meeting voice channel with a physical microphone, virtual audio output, Control+Option+T push-to-talk, and an explicit original-voice pass-through option. - Added bounded audio queues, connection status, in-memory transcripts, device-loss handling, and cancellation when the Mac sleeps or its session becomes inactive. - Added localized controls and permission descriptions in English, Ukrainian, French, and Italian.
## Requirements and current limitations
- Live Translation requires internet access and a Gemini API key with access to the preview translation model. Selected audio is sent to Google and may incur API charges. - Application audio capture requires macOS 14.2 or later and Screen & System Audio Recording permission. Use headphones for meetings. - Sending your voice into a meeting requires a separately installed virtual audio device, such as BlackHole 2ch. Choose that device as the meeting app's microphone and physical headphones as its speakers. - Browser selection covers application audio, not an individual tab. Dubbing has a translation delay and does not synchronize video lips. - This is the first implementation for testing. Automated checks pass, but the live Gemini translation probe has not completed successfully. Real process-tap capture, the end of a push-to-talk phrase, and compatibility in Meet, Zoom, Teams, Telegram and WhatsApp still require end-to-end validation. Existing dictation remains available.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.7
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 7
- Added an optional freeform Gemini voice command for selected text. - Assign a separate global shortcut, select text in any supported app, hold the shortcut, speak any editing instruction, and release to run it through Gemini. - The freeform mode accepts the complete spoken instruction and does not require a saved command or an exact eight-word phrase. - The default Gemini command shortcut is Control+Option+G, can be changed in Settings, and cannot duplicate the dictation shortcut. - Local speech models keep the command audio on the Mac; only the recognized instruction and selected text are sent to Gemini. - Results use the existing Preview, Replace, or Copy preference for selected-text actions.

item.title: 0.8.0-beta.6
item.description:
# Pysano 0.8.0 Beta 6
- Fixed voice actions for text selected in read-only content, including browser pages, Mail messages, and Telegram/Electron views. - Pysano now prioritizes an existing text selection even when the accessibility node is not editable or focused. - Added support for the text-marker selections used by WebKit and Chromium, including selection bounds for placing the floating preview near the selected text. - Added a bounded search inside the active window for applications that expose the selected text on a descendant accessibility node. - Selection contents are still captured only from the frontmost application, secure fields remain blocked, and replacement continues to revalidate the original selection before pasting.

# Pysano 0.7.1
- The **Repair Key Access** action now rebuilds the legacy Keychain item's ACL once for Pysano's stable code signature, preventing an unlock prompt on every launch. - The API key remains in Keychain; there are no automatic system prompts and the key is never saved to project files. - Added four feedback sound sets: Liquid, Soft Chime, Pulse, and macOS System. - Liquid is the new default short cue. Every option can be previewed in Settings without starting a recording, and sound feedback can still be disabled completely.

# Pysano 0.7.0
- Made the dictation indicator smaller and moved its default position to the top so it does not cover the input field. - Added top, bottom, left, and right indicator placement options. - The completion message can be hidden or displayed for 0.5, 1, 2, or 4 seconds; the default is 1 second. - Added native macOS sounds at recording start and completion, with a separate sound toggle.

# Pysano 0.6.2
- Added a focused-node fallback for ChatGPT, Codex, and other Chromium/Electron/WebKit editors that expose `AXGroup` or `AXWebArea` instead of a standard text AX role. - Before insertion, Pysano revalidates the original app, window, and Accessibility node; password and secure containers remain blocked. - A missing Accessibility permission is no longer masked by an unknown text-field message. - After a failed attempt, the menu offers sanitized focus diagnostics that exclude field text, selection, keystrokes, and clipboard contents.
